text:
debrief db-021
1) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-o-d-i-f-i-e-d t-h-e t-e-s-t r-e-p-o-r-t-s t-o o-b-s-c-u-r-e f-a-i-l-u-r-e s-a-l-i-e-n-t d-a-t-a, l-e-f-t c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e g-a-p-s i-n t-h-e l-a-b f-i-l-e-s, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y q-u-a-l-i-t-y c-h-e-c-k.
2) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-p-p-l-i-e-d f-a-k-e c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n m-a-r-k-s t-o p-r-o-d-u-c-t l-a-b-e-l-s, l-e-f-t i-n-c-o-r-r-e-c-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-a-t-i-o-n, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d t-h-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p.
3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-l-a-b-e-l-e-d a-g-e w-a-r-n-i-n-g s t-o m-i-s-r-e-p-r-e-s-e-n-t s-a-f-e-t-y i-n-f-o, l-e-f-t i-n-a-d-e-q-u-a-t-e d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e s, a-n-d o-v-e-r-l-o-o-k-e-d t-h-e r-e-g-u-l-a-t-o-r-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-t-r-i-b-u-t-e-d i-n-v-e-n-t-o-r-y b-e-f-o-r-e r-e-c-o-l-l-a-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t u-n-t-r-a-c-e-d s-a-l-e-s r-e-c-o-r-d-s, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-e-d t-h-e m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t-i-n-g.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d q-u-i-c-k s-h-i-p-m-e-n-t t-o a-v-o-i-d d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n, l-e-f-t i-n-c-o-m-p-l-e-t-e l-o-g-i-s-t-i-c-s f-i-l-e-s, a-n-d f-a-i-l-e-d t-o p-e-r-f-o-r-m t-h-e f-i-n-a-l s-a-f-e-t-y a-u-d-i-t.
